forward.implementation: Forward power publishes a resisted temporary paralysis and once-only contact/final-tail ownership.
forward.scope_limit: Narrow combat paralysis, not general magic. Physical captures and endpoint policies retain original limits.

block_costs.implementation: Prepared block contact uses base mastery for separate Fatigue/equipment wear and atomic publication.
block_costs.scope_limit: Apprentice shield, Journeyman Creature weapon and lower-Hand runtime contexts are pairwise; L1 thresholds remain required.

recoil.implementation: Lower-Hand zero-absorption defense joins the general-hit owner and publishes the selected Recoil once.
recoil.scope_limit: Normal nonproc/SAN proc are pairwise build coverage; no extra dedicated Cartesian campaigns implied.

counter.implementation: Counter-first defense selects shield Block or bare Hand skill and stages native reactions/disarm atomically.
counter.scope_limit: Shield-specific eligibility has World coverage; linked Counter/unarmed/selected-Player runtime proofs are pairwise, not a dedicated shield proc course.

armor_wear.implementation: Selected body armor wear commits native conditions/RNG once using the reviewed mastery factors.
armor_wear.scope_limit: Pairwise non-saturating Light25 normal and selected Heavy50 SAN contacts, each with actual before/after fresh proofs; retained Light100 normal/SAN wear reinspected. Other type/rank thresholds retain L1/World coverage; no dedicated Heavy25 or Light50 runtime claim.

burden.implementation: Live Player/NPC inventory burden discounts the worn instance using base mastery and winning settings.
burden.scope_limit: Before/after movement fresh proofs and mixed/spare controls; no exact trajectory claim.

rating.implementation: Live armor aggregation uses weighted light/heavy coverage, base mastery and restored Hair/Head equipment.
rating.scope_limit: All-light versus mixed normal/SAN contacts and actual before/after fresh sources; other appearance/material requirements remain separate.

s4_delivery_review.remaining: Resolve actual C1/R3/I4/Q5/V6 requirement gaps, final independent clean campaigns and Section10 gates. Preserve row-specific runtime scope limits; no new test executions inferred.
